result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that is mostly rendering correctly, but there are a few visual issues including a loading spinner overlaying a restaurant image and some content being cut off at the screen edges.

issues.description: A loading spinner is overlaid on the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, indicating the image or card content is still loading or stuck.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load fully and remove the spinner once loaded, or add a proper loading placeholder that doesn't obscure content.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal list has the third item (Trattoria Piccol...) cut off at the right edge with truncated text.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scroll, but ensure adequate padding and clear affordance that the list scrolls to reveal more items.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card under 'Popular right now' is cut off by the viewport, showing only partial content.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but verify the card fully renders when scrolled into view.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icons have inconsistent styling — one is a white outline on the ramen card and another appears dark filled on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon appearance and contrast across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
